subject.title: fix(media): bound ffmpeg conversion wait with a timeout

question: Should unsupported-media conversion adopt the proposed fixed 60-second maximum runtime?
rationale: The patch correctly prevents indefinite blocking, but current behavior has no runtime ceiling and the repository has no established evidence that every legitimate CAF or GIF conversion completes within 60 seconds.

options.title: Accept 60 seconds
options.body: Land the patch and intentionally treat conversions exceeding 60 seconds as failed optional conversions.

options.title: Choose another bound
options.body: Select a longer or adaptive internal deadline and validate both a deliberately hung converter and a legitimate slow-success case before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept 60 seconds
recommendation.body: Land the patch and intentionally treat conversions exceeding 60 seconds as failed optional conversions.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced this conversion feature and authored its previous hang-related maintenance commit.
